Change c0392. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. III; 1831 Ch. XX.

Context before (unchanged): Their faces expressed a mixture of curiosity and anger, which annoyed, and in some degree alarmed me.

1818 text: I inquired the way to the inn; but no one replied.

1831 text: I enquired the way to the inn; but no one replied.

Diff: I [-inquired-] {+enquired+} the way to the inn; but no one replied.

Context after (unchanged): I then moved forward, and a murmuring sound arose from the crowd as they followed and surrounded me; when an ill-looking man approaching, tapped me on the shoulder, and said, "Come, Sir, you must follow me to Mr. Kirwin's, to give an account of yourself."

result.rationale: Only the orthography changes: "inquired" becomes "enquired" with identical meaning and no change in wording, events, or characterization.
